notes.title: Forgiveness Update Phase 2 (Light Edition)
notes.notes:
Next big update is here! 

It's a good day to be a shrimp! (Well if you aren't doing a crazy ritual ofc)

I got myself a new PC late NOV of 2024. Mid December I got my PC setup with all my programs ready and set. Now I am back and able to post Updates to SHRiMP at a BETTER pace. I can work much faster with this new PC so lots of good content is on the way. I decided to work on a light version of this update to get something out for all of you. This updates focuses on Porcelain Ghost adding new skins and called out sounds to him that are horrifying. It brings in the ability to customize the stereo too! there's new skins for the OG stereo to unlock, there's 2 new models to unlock, and you can customize the emission colors on the stereo. 

Thank you for being patient with me as I had NOT uploaded a major build for almost a whole year. Feels good to be back. The Next update will be the rest of Phase 2 which changes level 10 and adds much more refreshing content in the game. After this update there is still so much to do and I am excited for it.

notes.title: Incoming Patch Later This Week.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I want to list some bugs in the game you will come across:
There are issues with the entity False Car. When it screams the screen gets distorted. That distortion causes some frame rate issues. So if you experience a loss of frames as it screams just know I am aware of that and will be patching that out. 

The tutorials on False Car are in the wrong order and False Car moves for some reason when disabled.

Jumping is supposed to be disabled on Level 13 and even most abilities yet for some reason it is not. 

Final bug is minor. On level 14 Sobriquet's path system is incorrect near the end of the level. He walks 
back where he went before which he is not supposed to do that. Him walking back does not affect progression of the level in any way. It is funny to see him walk back as he talks. 

Last note: I do need to add an individual track list option on the stereo and maybe I might add in a vibe mechanic since it sounds cool. In the future there will be controller support and Steam achievements.
